categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches P2P label and modifies net_processing.cpp to change how in-flight blocks are counted during compact block relay.
categories.rationale: Fixes a bug where historical blocks from assumeutxo background sync unnecessarily prevent the node from requesting tip blocks via compact blocks. During background sync, nodes fall back to requesting full blocks instead of compact blocks, wasting bandwidth and slowing tip block propagation, though block relay still functions via the fallback.
